mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 4.0%, it signals economic weakness triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% or Rank IC for threshold condition < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in GDP growth and industrial production indicates robust economic momentum that drives positive equity valuations and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >40% of expansion instances or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of monetary easing with low inflation (FEDFUNDS ≤ 2.5% and CPIAUCSL ≤ 2.0%), accommodative policy and stable prices support equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in the defined regime (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for regime condition < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS growth over 5-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS grows (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1300.0 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic activity, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where HOUST > 1300.0 or Rank IC for threshold condition < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in unemployment signals recessionary pressures with aggressive monetary easing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >40% of instances or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing weakness signals economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 or Rank IC for threshold condition < 0.03.
